about_the_game:
A THRILLING STRATEGIC ROGUE-LIKE EXPERIENCE FOR ALL PLAYERS WHO SEEK TO CHALLENGE THE MERCY OF TIME!

Spinera blends high-stakes roguelike slot mechanics with civi-building strategy. Every spin can lead your civilization to golden ages of prosperity or the brink of collapse. Do you have the strategy to outsmart the Cycle of Fate?

Spin. Build. Conquer.

Harness the power of the slot machine to gather vital resources, but remember: the reels only provide the raw materials. It is up to you to combine your spin results with cutting-edge technologies and tactical brilliance. From the dawn of time to the space age, your mission is to surpass the required Era Score to advance your people. Every advantage you secure is a stepping stone toward the next age. Will you master the odds or be lost to the sands of time?

  • Infinite Replayability: No two empire are the same. Combine unique leader abilities with different kinds of technologies; experience events with unexpected outcomes.

  • Strategic Risk Management: Master the odds. Build your slot machine deck, prioritize your symbols, and pivot your strategy to survive the changing eras.

  • Vibrant Art Style: Watch history unfold through charming, high-quality visuals, from legendary Wonders to iconic historical leaders.

Your journey begins with a choice. In Spinera, leaders are more than just flavor; they are the blueprint for your strategy.

  • Rule-Breaking Traits: Every leader interacts with your resources differently. Command Napoleon to harness the power of your people’s spirit, allowing you to train powerful soldiers using Culture resources instead of just Military might, or rule as Cleopatra to give you economy boost.

  • Starting Advantages: Hit the ground running with immediate bonuses. Some leaders grant an instant +10 boost to specific resources and add an amount of specific resources to your starting deck to define your early-game momentum.

Don't just leave your fate to chance—engineer it. In Spinera, your scientific progress is the key to outsmarting the odds. Spend your gathered Science resources to trigger breakthroughs and reshape your civilization's future.

  • Automated Prosperity: Science cards grant powerful passive abilities that work for you every single turn. Such as generating specific resources automatically after a spin, these cards ensure your civilization never stops growing.

  • Targeted Multipliers: Use technology to tip the odds in your favor. Research cards that provide multiplier chances for specific resources, allowing you to focus your strategy on a single resource and turn a lucky spin into a game-breaking windfall.

When your civilization reaches a cultural peak, history’s greatest icons emerge to offer their expertise. Spend your Culture resources to draft legendary figures like Sun Tzu, Aristotle, or Homer for immediate, high-impact interventions.

  • Strategic Burst Effects: Unlike Science, Great Minds provide powerful one-time bonuses that can turn the tide of a run. Use them to generate a sudden windfall of resources exactly when you need it to bridge the gap to the next Era.

  • Deck Modification: Master your deck by using Culture to enhance specific resources. Permanently upgrade and add your most valuable resources to the deck to ensure your best combos are always in play.

Wonders are the ultimate milestones of your civilization’s power. Construct massive landmarks like Stonehenge or the Pyramids on top of your slot machine to fundamentally change the rules of the game for your run.

  • Strategic Resource Targets: Every Wonder focuses on a specific resource. Place your Wonder anywhere on your slot machine—if its designated resource lands on the Wonder’s tiles after a spin, you trigger its unique Passive Effect. It turns your slot machine into a tactical "landing zone" for your most valuable symbols.

  • The "Wild" Joker Mechanic: Building a Wonder immediately adds a "Wild" symbol into your deck. These act as Jokers, bridging the gap between different resources to complete lines and trigger massive combos.

History is written by the victors. As you progress, your civilization will face trials and enemies that threaten to halt your advancement. You must balance your greed for growth with the necessity of defense.

  • Defend Your Progress: Use your spins to generate military power and train soldiers. Without a strong defense, random events and rival eras will strip you of your hard-earned resources.

  • Tactical Buffs: When the battlefield gets tough, call on your Great Minds. Use Culture-driven cards to double the attack power or bolster the health of your army in a single turn, turning a desperate defense into a crushing counter-attack.

‘Every civilization needs a bit of luck to survive.’

                                                        -Luckus Aurelius
